text:
Sam: Heads up — need to lock the onboarding + negotiation flow for the private beta design partners. Proposal: recruit 6 partners, 8-week engagement, 2 incentive tiers (credit-only and premium support + co-marketing). Anyone opposed?
Priya: +1 on 6 being manageable. What are hard gates for acceptance? Security review timeline?
Ethan: Recommend: quick security checklist before invite (NDA, data-handling questionnaire), full SOC2 or customer review only after selection. That keeps ramp fast.
Zoe: Agree. Also propose feedback cadence: weekly short async surveys + biweekly 45m syncs. Deliverables: prompt set + evals at week 0 and week 6.
Sam: Acceptance gates: 1) committed SLO for response time/workload (sample qps), 2) legal ok on data handling, 3) one internal contact + regular usage plan. If any of these fail -> not accepted.
Priya: Incentive pitches: Tier A (early access + $5k credits + priority queue), Tier B (everything in A + 3 days dedicated SE time + co-marketing). Do we want to cap Tier B to 2 partners?
Ethan: Yes cap Tier B to 2. Also recommend adding rollback clause: we can pause integration if safety regressions appear. Add to contract.
Zoe: Success metrics to measure: integration completion, weekly active users, per-request latency under target, qualitative feedback score >=4/5 in week 6. Also measure cost per active user.
Sam: Good. For negotiation we should be flexible on credits but firm on SLAs and data ops. Draft script for outreach? Short, transparent email + 30m intro call.
Priya: Draft outreach lines: "Join our private beta for private deployments — get dedicated support, influence roadmap, and receive credits." Add clear asks: usage goals, security contact, expected data types.
Ethan: I'll draft the security questionnaire and contract addendum. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Zoe: I'll outline the feedback templates and weekly survey. Also create a lightweight eval harness for the partners to run (instructions + baseline tests).
Sam: Awesome. @deploy-bot can you drop the signup form link + template NDA here?
deploy-bot: Form: https://rwd.in/join-private-beta  NDA template: https://rwd.in/nda-template
Priya: Let's run a 1-hour negotiation rehearsal on Thurs 10am before outreach goes live.
Sam: Done — calendar invite sent. Thanks team, moving to action items: Priya -> outreach copy, Ethan -> security questionnaire + addendum, Zoe -> eval + surveys, Sam -> negotiation playbook and SLA template.
Priya: I'll post the initial outreach doc in #product-docs once ready. :thumbsup:
Ethan: Will loop in legal for the addendum.
Zoe: Starting eval harness tomorrow, will ping when ready.
Sam: Closing the thread — we'll review rehearsal outcomes and finalize partner list by Fri.
